تحتسبين (form VIII)
# تَحْتَسِبِينَ (taḥtasibīna) /taħ.ta.si.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
# تُحْتَسَبِينَ (tuḥtasabīna) /tuħ.ta.sa.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
